body:
I had just finished the whole salvia experience, I was still feeling a slight head buzz and I decided to smoke the passion flower I had found. After smoking a bit I felt pretty calm, like meditative state, my friend who smokes a ton of pot said it didnt do anything for him, and my other friend who hardly does anything said it made him pretty calm and nice, we both would like to take it before trying to go to sleep because we are hyper.
